description: This PHP source file defines a class smpl_Invoice_Sample that generates an invoice PDF template with methods for retrieving the template type, body, header, and footer. It references external services and translation functions to build the invoice layout.

classes.name: smpl_Invoice_Sample
classes.description: A class that provides methods to generate invoice PDF content, including header, footer, and body layout.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document, which is 'AOS_Invoices'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML content for the invoice PDF body, including company info, invoice details, and itemized list.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string as header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Constructs and returns the HTML content for the invoice PDF footer, including page number and date.
